notes.en:
## New Features

- Integrate Command Code with model discovery and quota display. Configure protocols per model and choose whether each Codex credential may use paid credits.
- Name sessions at creation time. Immediate guidance now waits at block boundaries without interrupting ongoing reasoning or text output.
- Rework the file editor with lightweight sessions, bounded clean-document caching, recoverable local drafts, format-preserving editing, streamed reads/uploads and atomic local/remote saves. Subscribe to file changes with reconnect recovery.
- Open Windows Explorer through the narrafork:// protocol.

## Improvements

- Preserve inline positions of quotes and attachments after sending, unify quote styling, preview attachments directly, and open quote details in a modal. Simplify draft synchronization with last-write-wins and an undo slot.
- Unify narrator runtime registration and background-work tracking, preventing premature completion notifications while wake-capable work is active.
- Replace persistent workspace write barriers with short per-file queues. Separate actual file-write results from history availability and retain successful items during partial restores.
- Run selected SQLite reads in read-only workers and distinguish slow endpoints from event-loop blocking in diagnostics.

## Fixes

- Improve message-jump targeting, file-panel execution identity, composer cursor navigation, fullscreen layering and Enter behavior.
- Fix attachment MIME normalization, whitespace/layout inconsistencies, draft recovery indicators, Git filter-bar height and Windows title-bar interactions.
- Improve compiled-worker loading, remote-save receipt recovery, model-history snapshots and cross-platform editor reliability.

## Upgrade Notes

- Published to the beta / prerelease channel. Requires the independently released executor-v0.9.4; helpers-v1.0.0 is unchanged.
- New narrators default to Allow All permissions; review the permission mode when creating sessions.
- Includes database migrations for runtime registration, draft undo, editor recovery and file-write history. Back up your database before upgrading. Legacy workspace barriers and administrator unlock controls are retired.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 集成 Command Code，支持模型发现与额度显示；可逐模型选择协议，并按 Codex 凭据选择是否使用付费积分额度。
- 新建会话时可指定标题；即时引导改为在块边界接入，不再打断正在进行的思考或文本输出。
- 文件编辑器采用轻量会话与有界干净文档缓存，支持本地草稿恢复、无损格式编辑、流式读取与上传、本地及远端原子保存，以及可重连恢复的文件变化订阅。
- Windows 支持通过 narrafork:// 协议在资源管理器中定位文件。

## 改进

- 发送后保留引用和附件在正文中的位置，统一引用样式，支持直接预览附件与弹窗查看引用详情；草稿同步简化为最后写入生效并提供撤销槽。
- 统一叙述者运行登记和后台工作追踪；仍有可唤醒后台任务时不提前发送完成通知。
- 以单文件短队列替代永久工作区写入屏障，分别报告实际写入结果与历史可用性；部分文件恢复失败时保留已成功项。
- 部分 SQLite 查询移至只读 worker，慢接口诊断区分接口自身耗时与主线程阻塞。

## 修复

- 改善消息跳转定位、文件面板执行身份、输入框光标导航、全屏层级与 Enter 换行行为。
- 修复附件 MIME 规范化、空白文本与排版偏差、草稿恢复提示、Git 筛选条高度及 Windows 标题栏交互。
- 改善编译版 worker 加载、远端保存回执恢复、模型历史快照与跨平台编辑器可靠性。

## 升级说明

- 本版本发布到 beta / prerelease 通道，依赖独立发布的 executor-v0.9.4；helpers-v1.0.0 保持不变。
- 新建叙述者的默认权限模式改为全部允许，创建会话时请核对权限模式。
- 包含运行登记、草稿撤销、编辑器恢复与文件写入历史的数据库迁移，升级前请备份数据库；旧工作区屏障与管理员解锁入口退役。
